reviews.text: No more impulsive buying. I have fungal acne and perioral dermatitis. It has been difficult to find a single solution that can address both issues because their treatments are quite different. I have an enormous collection of many skincare products that have only made things worse. I stopped making impulsive purchases due to paid marketing after downloading "Lumi." I can now simply check triggers and ingredients on a single app. forever grateful!!

Best of its kind. This app is an absolute game-changer for anyone who cares about ingredient safety in cosmetics! Its AI-powered scanner instantly analyzes products and provides a clear safety ranking, breaking down ingredients and highlighting potential allergens or harmful components. The interface is sleek and easy to use, making it perfect for quick checks while shopping. What I love most is the transparency it doesn’t just give you a score but explains why, empowering you to make informed choices. Since using it, I’ve confidently swapped out harmful products for safer options, and it’s completely transformed my beauty routine. Highly recommend!
